description: Agent Treasury: submit two or more conversion quotes (from and to assets, amounts in and out, any stated rate, fee and fee percentage, and expiry). The signed report computes each effective rate, ranks the quotes, gives the spread between the best and each other quote as a percentage, and flags any quote whose stated fee does not reconcile with its amounts and rate, and any expired quote. Supplied quotes only; live market pricing is wever_market-data-check and wever_fair-value-brief. Verdict ranked, fee_mismatch_found or not_comparable. POST /api/exchange-quote-check. Reads only the material in the call: no wallet, chain, market, bank or counterparty lookup, and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-treasury-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-treasury/.

as_of.description: The time to hold quote expiry against. Defaults to the time of the check.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

amount_out.description: The amount the quote delivers, after its fee.

fee_asset.description: Asset of the fee. Defaults to from_asset.

fee_percent.description: The stated fee as a percentage.

rate.description: The stated rate before fees, in to_asset per from_asset.

name: wever_exchange-quote-check
title: Exchange quote check
